source.quote: In many jurisdictions, excise taxes make up a large proportion of the cost of beer charged to our customers. The aggregate deduction from revenue recorded by us in relation to these taxes was USD 15.2 billion and USD 14.9 billion for the years ended 31 December 2024 and 2023, respectively.

exciseNote.note: Excise is deducted from revenue, so the USD 15.2bn AB InBev collects and pays to governments as excise is outside paidOut.

notes: IFRS, USD. Interest paid, interest received, dividends received and income tax paid are all inside 'Cash flow from/(used in) operating activities', so nothing is added. Revenue is net of excise (USD 15.2bn deducted), so revenueIncludesExcise is false and excise paid to governments is not in paidOut. Capex is the combined PP&E-and-intangibles line.
